planSteps.description: Navigate to the model-authored experience gallery
Open the pipeline-model experience that passed deterministic gates

Verify the first viewport uses a two-column hero: readable promise and first-climb action on the left, plus a climbing photograph on the right occupying roughly one third to one half of the hero width with both the climber and wall visibly inside its bordered frame
Select the option for building climbing technique
Verify the route-finder recommendation updates to the Intro to Bouldering starting path with a relevant next action
Navigate to the frequently asked questions section
Complete the inquiry form with valid sample contact details and a short project note
Verify the submitted inquiry is replaced by an honest local-demo notice explaining that nothing was sent and providing a direct contact fallback
